title: Electronic Payment Processing Implementation Specialist
description:
Electronic Payment Processing Implementation Specialist

Customer Intelligence Inc. is a professional consulting service and marketing firm, providing cutting-edge services to help customers grow. CI specializes in the financial industry and works with clients across multiple industries, payment brands, processing systems, and other enterprises with a focus on LATAM.

PROFILING

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Business, Computer Science, or Engineering , with a Master's degree being an added advantage.

EXPERIENCE

The ideal candidate for this role should possess the following experience and skills:

  • +3 years of experience in project management and technical implementation knowledge preferable (not obligatory) in the electronic payments industry , with a focus on customer processing implementation projects
  • Relevant experience in “Information Technology” system knowledge, with strong understanding of network technology, applications, and project management.
  • Strong payment transaction processing and industry business principles knowledge.
  • Strong understanding of electronic payment processing systems, formats and associated customer host interface testing services and principles.
  • Ability to interact well with the customer, Sr. and Executive management.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with ability to leverage these skills in a teaching environment.
  • Ability to drive change in a technical work environment.
  • Ability to lead matrix organizations and cross-functional teams.
  • Self-Starter with ability to work independently.
  • API Knowledge for Java and open languages.
  • Relevant experience on Computing Network services.
  • Development systems methodologies knowledge.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish languages.
  • Are you motivated to be a part of driving a world beyond cash?
  • Have you good knowledge about electronic payment and related processes such as authorization, clearing and settlement?
  • Are you able to cope with a fast-changing and ambiguous environment?

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for an implementation specialist with good technical knowledge, preferably in the Electronic Payments industry to oversee the implementation of electronic payments processing business activities for customers. Responsibilities include project management, customer needs assessment, system impact analysis, customer testing, advising customers' processing support staff, ensuring implementation quality and reliability, and compliance with product rules and specifications.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • In a customer-facing environment, lead a cross-functional processing implementation project team of technical and non-technical electronic payment processing experts from the industry.
  • Deliver standard through complex implementation activities ensuring quality and reliability of the implementations.
  • Act as central point of contact for customers representatives throughout processing implementation project end-to-end execution.
  • Assess and document customer needs and according implementation impacts on customers’ core and non-core processing systems and platforms.
  • Define scope, plan and drive customer processing implementation projects of new electronic payments processing business activities following the global project coordination methodology.
  • Act as processing implementation advisor, to customers’ processing support staff. Provide guidance to execute all necessary processing implementation activities.
  • Execute extensive and comprehensive initial end-to-end processing system impact analyses for multiple key customer processing implementation projects in parallel.
  • Assure processing interfaces with electronic payment processing systems are compliant with global product rules, specifications, achieving KPIs and SLAs.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

  • A result-driven approach, groomed in all our associates, as long as all commitments with clients, internal and external to the firm, are accomplished.
  • An exciting and professional work environment.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Exposure to key decision makers in the industry in Latin America Continuous knowledge building initiatives to support your career growth.
  • A temporary contract with HIGH POSSIBILITY OF RENEWAL.

SOBRE A BRAÚNA

Fundada em 2015, a Braúna surgiu do sonho de profissionais com extensa experiência no mercado financeiro de criar uma empresa com um serviço diferenciado na maneira do cliente investir. Com alinhamento de interesses e visão de longo prazo, nosso objetivo é oferecer o melhor serviço, os melhores produtos e criar o mais completo e eficiente ecossistema de negócios do Brasil, com soluções para o mercado nacional e internacional. Deste sonho, temos acima de R$9 bilhões sob custódia e mais de 200 sócios alinhados com o ideal “Cliente em Primeiro Lugar”.

RESPONSABILIDADE E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Programa Seja Raiz:

O Seja Raiz é um programa de 6 meses, dividido em 2 fases, onde o/a trainee se desenvolverá para se especializar na área de maior sinergia.

1º Fase (3 meses):

  • Treinamentos comerciais para qualificação no atendimento a clientes.
  • Treinamentos técnicos sobre diversos produtos financeiros: investimentos, seguros de vida, consórcio, financiamento, planejamento financeiro pessoal, créditos, produtos PJs, câmbio, entre outros.
  • Responsabilidades:
    • Prospecção de clientes;
    • Mapeamento e estruturação da carteira de clientes;
    • Desenvolvimento de estratégias financeiras adequadas ao perfil dos clientes;
    • Apresentação de soluções financeiras;
    • Construção de relacionamento com os clientes;
    • Atualização sobre tendências do mercado financeiro

2º Fase (3 meses):

  • Avaliações para tomada de decisão para qual área o/a trainee tem maior sinergia: assessoria de investimentos, planejamento financeiro, aquisição de bens, planejamento patrimonial, áreas operacionais ou especialização em produtos financeiros específicos (renda variável, fixa, câmbio, FIIs, etc).
  • Treinamentos específicos para se tornar um especialista na área escolhida.

3º Fase:

  • Conclusão dos 6 meses com formatura.
  • Avaliações de desempenho e comportamental.
  • Início da jornada na Braúna em uma nova área.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Interesse na área comercial;
  • Ensino superior completo ou no último ano (qualquer área);
  • Morar em Campinas ou região;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpesssoal;
  • Diferenciais: Experiência no mercado financeiro e certificações (CPA-10/ CPA-20/ CEA/ CFP);
  • Gostar de desafios.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

  • Programa de incentivos financeiros;
  • Acesso a plataformas de capacitação exclusivas da Braúna;
  • Possibilidade de acesso ao Total Pass.

description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a Character Art Director to join our growing team on Fortnite. This person will lead and collaborate with multidisciplinary artists to help create and maintain Epic's vision. This person will have a balance of creative thinking and a strong ability to lead a team in developing content for our various projects. By working closely with the Senior Art Director, you will be accountable for identifying and communicating a high-quality visual style, as well as developing a team of artists and coaching them to do the same.

In this role, you will

  • Be highly creative. Imagine and communicate your vision to the team to develop new content that players will love.
  • Lead Art initiatives, working closely with other non-Art Teams including Design, Engineering, Product, and Marketing.
  • Strategize with Senior Leadership to help define the Art Team's direction and priorities.
  • Create and iterate unique and stunning character designs within a determined production schedule.
  • Direct and mentor a worldwide team of artists; delivering effective feedback across all art disciplines - modeling, animation, etc.
  • Collaborate with the Product and IP teams on themes and cosmetic sets.
  • Deliver effective feedback across all art disciplines - modeling, animation, etc.

What we're looking for

  • Experience as an art director with a character design background and understanding of the 2D and 3D process in a game studio.
  • A deep understanding of the game development process and art disciplines.
  • Experience with working with Product Management on new initiatives.
  • Solid technical background in art and game development.
  • Practical experience using Unreal.
  • Strong leadership skills in order to lead a large number of people toward a singular vision.
  • Strong collaborative nature to partner with senior art directors and discipline leads.
  • Strong understanding of art fundamentals, multiple art styles, anatomy, appeal, color theory, and how color affects mood & focal points - with a focus on modern fashion-forward aesthetics.
  • Experience designing characters of a wide variety with broad appeal and the ability to adapt to and innovate new styles and techniques.
  • Experience directing and supporting artists across multiple disciplines.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, but it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

title: Como Associado ou Consultor Associado
description:
Sobre a Charles River Associates:

A Charles River Associates tem sido, há mais de 50 anos, uma empresa pioneira de consultoria que oferece aos funcionários um lugar para colaborar e aprender com um grupo diversificado de consultores, especialistas do setor e acadêmicos. Na CRA, você se juntará a mentes líderes que usam análises econômicas, financeiras, técnicas e de negócios para resolver problemas complexos para uma lista impressionante de clientes, incluindo 99% dos 100 maiores escritórios de advocacia, 89% das empresas da Fortune 100 e agências governamentais em todo o mundo. A CRA oferece um ambiente colaborativo, com equipes que buscam a excelência do cliente, trazendo curiosidade, desenvoltura e iniciativa ao seu trabalho. Através de um ambiente colegiado, oportunidades formais e informais de treinamento e uma ampla gama de recursos de desenvolvimento profissional, sua experiência na CRA abrirá portas para você à medida que você acelera sua carreira.

Visão geral do trabalho

Como Associado ou Consultor Associado, você apoiará a equipe sênior na realização de avaliações de risco de Compliance, investigações contábeis forenses, pesquisa e análise de grande volume de dados. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com colegas no Brasil, nos Estados Unidos e na Europa, mas será fundamentalmente responsável pelo trabalho executado pela companhia do Brasil.

Você será responsável por trabalhar em atribuições de pesquisa, investigações financeiras, litígios e questões de disputa. As responsabilidades podem incluir (mas não se limitam a):

  • Investigar e analisar registros financeiros e contábeis em apoio a diversas investigações financeiras, como apropriação indébita de ativos, corrupção ou fraude nas demonstrações financeiras.
  • Realizar procedimentos contábeis forenses como parte de grandes investigações multidisciplinares que incorporam investigações tradicionais de pesquisas de antecedentes, conjuntos de dados complexos e análises técnicas contábeis ou econômicas.
  • Utilizar históricos econômico, contábil e/ou financeiro para apoiar especialistas seniores.
  • Preparar e apresentar materiais em relação às propostas e reuniões dos clientes.
  • Participar de iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios e desenvolvimento de práticas.
  • Apoiar a administração diária de compromissos, incluindo execução de planos de trabalho, orçamento e faturamento.
  • Revisar e sumariar documentos de clientes, depoimentos e outros documentos legais, relatórios de analistas e dados financeiros, para identificar informações-chave relevantes ao projeto.
  • Auxiliar na criação, desenvolvimento e controle de qualidade das entregas de clientes, incluindo análises financeiras, resumos de pesquisas, laudos periciais e outros materiais.

Qualificações

Estamos buscando candidatos para apoiar nossas crescentes ofertas de investigações. Os candidatos ideais devem possuir:

  • 2-4 anos de experiência de trabalho relevante em contabilidade forense ou área relacionada.
  • Fluência em português e inglês é obrigatória, pois essa pessoa interagirá frequentemente com escritórios internacionais.
  • Graduação em disciplinas relacionadas, como administração, direito ou contabilidade, com experiência prévia de consultoria sendo preferencial. Certificações profissionais são favoráveis, mas não necessárias.
  • Vontade de trabalhar em um ambiente empreendedor.
  • Habilidades analíticas, quanto a resolução de problemas e ótima comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Capacidade de priorizar várias tarefas, gerenciar vários fluxos de trabalho, estar atento aos detalhes e cumprir prazos.
  • Alto nível de iniciativa e curiosidade, ética de trabalho e dedicação à qualidade.

Como Associado ou Consultor Associado, você terá contato frequente com a liderança sênior e trabalhará em colaboração com os membros da sua equipe.

Now is the perfect time to join us and help accomplish our mission. If you’re inspired by purpose, thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment, and are ready to shape the future of payments, we’d love to hear from you!

About the role

We are seeking a skilled and go-getter Sr. Machine Learning Engineer to join our Data Science team and play a pivotal role in driving the model development/production lifecycle. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, MLOps, and DataOps teams to implement ML models for assessing transactional risk and fraud, enable automated model retraining, and support robust machine learning inference systems. This role is essential for ensuring efficient, reliable, and scalable workflows to power data-driven insights and machine learning solutions.


What you will do:

  • Model Development and Optimization: Design the data-architecture flow for the efficient implementation of real-time model endpoints and/or batch solutions.
  • Data Exploration and Feature Engineering: Engineer domain-specific features that can enhance model performance and robustness.
  • Productionization of ML Models: Build pipelines to deploy machine learning models in production with a focus on scalability and efficiency, and participate in and enforce the release management process for models and rules.
  • Monitoring, Maintenance & Improvement: Implement systems to monitor model performance, endpoints/feature health, and other business metrics; Create model-retraining pipelines to boost performance, based on monitoring metrics; Model recalibration.
  • Scalable System Design: Design and implement scalable architectures to support real-time/batch solutions; Optimize algorithms and workflows for latency, throughput, and resource efficiency; Ensure systems adhere to company standards for reliability and security.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Conduct research and prototypes to explore novel approaches in ML engineering for addressing emerging risk/fraud patterns.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with fraud analysts, risk managers, and product teams to translate business requirements into ML solutions.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in CS/Engineering/Data-Science or other technical disciplines.
  • Solid experience in DS/ML engineering.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Hands-on experience in implementing batch and real-time streaming pipelines, using SQL and NoSQL database solutions.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools for data pipelines, streaming systems, and model performance.
  • Experience in AWS cloud services (Sagemaker, EC2, EMR, ECS/EKS, RDS, etc.).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation), and MLOps platforms like MLflow.
  • Experience with Machine Learning modeling, notably tree-based and boosting models supervised learning for imbalanced target scenarios.
  • Experience with Online Inference, APIs, and services that respond under tight time constraints.
  • Proficiency in English.

    • It will be a "plus" if you have:

    • Prior experience with ML applied to financial decision-making, such as credit risk, and fraud prevention.
    • Prior experience with AWS Sagemaker and/or similar DS/ML workbench.
    • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
    • Feature store development and integration experience.
    • Experience with distributed data systems such as Kafka, Spark, Hadoop, and workflow/data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).

Are you looking for a challenging career in business-development? Do you have prior experience and a proven track-record in delivering against targets in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Amazon is looking for a Global Selling Account Managers to join its team based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
Your role will be focused on contributing to new business acquisition (50% of the time) through hunting, specifically phone/email-based prospecting of new merchants who can bring their competitive range of products, pricing and availability to Amazon. You will also work with merchants as an account manager (50% of the time) – helping them to launch and grow their business on Amazon by ensuring they understand Amazon’s products, services, systems and tools. Lastly you will be responsible for using feedback from the merchants to identify opportunities to improve Amazon’s products, services, processes, systems and tools.
Key job responsibilities
- Identify, prospect and recruit high-potential merchants via phone or email
- Effectively prioritize and manage a pipeline of merchants to consistently meet/exceed quarterly targets
- Be a business partner for new merchants providing them with data-driven insights and advice to optimize their success on Amazon
- Work closely with new merchants, educating them about Amazon’s high standards of Delivery and Customer Experience
- Enable merchants to learn and master Amazon's tools and systems so they may become self-sufficient in managing their catalog, inventory and performance efficiently and to the required standards
- Learn and understand the specificities of your categories to spot trends, seasonal items and competitive pricing to best tailor your pitch and advice to merchants
- Track and report business development results, analyze, interpret reports and information for your portfolio of merchants
- Prioritize your time optimally to achieve your targets in a KPI-driven environment
A day in the life
A typical day begins with reviewing performance metrics and pipeline status before diving into proactive outreach to potential merchants. Throughout the morning, you'll conduct virtual meetings with new sellers, providing comprehensive onboarding support and guidance through Amazon's Seller Central platform. The afternoon focuses on analyzing merchant data, conducting business reviews, and offering strategic recommendations for growth. You'll continuously monitor category trends, evaluate competitive pricing, and ensure merchants maintain Amazon's high standards for delivery and customer experience. The day involves balancing reactive support with proactive business development, all while tracking progress against quarterly targets and updating necessary reports in the CRM system. Participation in external events may apply.
About the team
Our dynamic, multicultural team is dedicated to expanding Amazon's global marketplace by enabling merchants worldwide to reach international customers. Operating at the intersection of technology and international commerce, we help businesses navigate multiple marketplaces, local regulations, and cultural nuances. Our team combines diverse perspectives from professionals across different regions and languages, working together to break down cross-border selling barriers. We pride ourselves on our data-driven approach, entrepreneurial spirit, and commitment to merchant success. Join us in shaping the future of global e-commerce while maintaining Amazon's customer-centric focus.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience prospecting, qualifying, and cold-calling companies
- Experience in procurement, negotiation, sales, consulting, supply chain, product/project management, or marketing
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools
- Experience and track record of exceeding sales goals
- Experience within e-commerce or Retail fields

Senior/Account Manager (Company Management Services)

Responsible for managing a portfolio of clients to guide them on legal, administrative and corporate activities for their companies. The role-holder is responsible for setting up and maintaining in good standing the corporate and legal structures on behalf of clients. The role holder generates revenue based on value-charging by carrying out legal, administrative and corporate activities, promotes products and services and actively participates in growing the business from existing clients as well as identifying prospective clients through client referrals.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for managing the portfolios of clients and guide them on corporate services inclusive of the setting up and administration of corporate structures and other corporate governance services
  • Work directly with our clients in analyzing and interpreting regulations, procedures, documents relating to our clients’ legal and fiscal opportunities;
  • Actively participating in growing and marketing our business both with existing clients to grow the portfolio but also to develop new business through client referrals.
  • Administering a portfolio of companies, limited partnerships and trusts in accordance with applicable legislation.
  • Monitor, manage, verify and approve the preparation of minutes of shareholder meetings (Ordinary or Extraordinary), and proxies, list of attendance;
  • Coordinate issues concerning taxes, administration, and banking of client companies with the Client Accounting Department.
  • Fully understand the client’s activities and make sure that any action taken is consistent with the company’s activities and purpose within the legal and economic framework for the company.
  • Manage companies and ensure that all information in the client files is correct and up-to-date.
  • Monitor productivity and chargeability on weekly basis and review productivity and performance against targets. to ensure that individual financial and client targets are met.
  • Accurately record chargeable time and value of service using Maconomy in order to facilitate timely invoices.
  • Ensure that all correspondence is signed in conformity with the signatory authority list.
  • Solve payment problems, as well as collection of outstanding invoices;
  • Ensure that “Know Your Customer” rules are adhered to and that client operates within relevant compliance frameworks.
  • Comply with all internal procedures regarding the correct use of automated programs for recording all required client and company data.
  • Maintain up-to-date local office policies and procedures in alignment with local regulations and requirements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to the client and adhere to the regular client contact/ communication guidelines set by the Company, aimed at building personal and long-term relationship with the clients.

OTHER DUTIES

  • Undertake the role of director, trustee, nominee, manager, partner, secretary, authorized signatory or any related position in internal entities or client entities of Amicorp Group, where necessary and required by the Management.
  • Undertake such other duties, related to the position, as may from time to time be agreed with Management.

Qualifications, Skills, and Experience

  • Bachelor or Master Degree in Law, Business, Accounting, Tax or another business related field, additional relevant qualification would be desirable.
  • At least 4 years of relevant working experience within the corporate services business and/or financial services sectors (preferably with international exposure). Additional relevant company secretary or company law qualifications would be highly beneficial;
  • Good understanding of key financial services and industry related legislation. Familiar with international requirements - e.g. CRS, FATCA, BEPS, GAAR, ESR, that affects the clients and entities in target markets.
  • Strong commercial mindset, takes initiative, positive and proactive, dedicated, focused and revenue and target driven.
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Excellent client facing skills. Well-developed spoken and written communication skills and the ability to tailor style to relevant audiences, and successfully liaise with people at different levels. Excellent English language fluency; additional languages preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills, solution driven, highly organized and detail-orientated with good decision making and time management skills. Independent, hands-on and takes accountability to deliver solutions and results.
  • Ability to adapt and work in a smaller, dynamic local team environment; along with being part of a bigger matrix organization. Proven leadership and team player skills, with ambition to excel in the role.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of operational efficiency issues and quality management and control matters.

About Fastn

Fastn is on a mission to revolutionize how SaaS companies connect with their customers' environments. Powered by AI, we provide an embedded integration infrastructure that enables SaaS businesses to build, scale, and manage their integration ecosystems effortlessly.

With Fastn, companies can launch strategic integrations, create their own app marketplace, and unlock new revenue streams by offering seamless connectivity with the tools their customers already use. Our platform goes beyond integrations — it accelerates adoption, drives product-led growth, and delivers smarter, more valuable customer experiences.

If you're passionate about crafting world-class user experiences and solving complex UX challenges in a fast-paced startup environment, Fastn is the place to be.

What You'll Do

As a Senior UX Designer, you'll be the driving force behind user experience design at Fastn. You will lead UX initiatives across our platform, ensuring that every interaction is seamless, intuitive, and empowering for our users. From onboarding to feature discovery, your designs will directly impact product adoption, satisfaction, and retention.

Your Responsibilities

  • Lead UX design across the Fastn platform—from user flows and wireframes to high-fidelity UI and prototypes.
  • Own and evolve Fastn's design system to ensure consistency across all touchpoints.
  • Design intuitive workflows for complex technical tasks, including onboarding, integration setup, and feature adoption.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and interviews to validate and iterate on design decisions.
  • Build and test design prototypes to gather feedback from internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and leadership to align designs with product goals.
  • Champion a user-centered design culture and help establish UX best practices within the company.

What We're Looking For

We're seeking a seasoned UX designer with a track record of building exceptional SaaS experiences and solving complex problems through elegant design. If you thrive in early-stage environments and enjoy shaping design culture from the ground up, we want to talk to you.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • 8 - 10+ years of UX design experience, preferably in SaaS or complex web applications.
  • Early-stage startup experience in the B2B space.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end design work with a focus on user-centered problem-solving.
  • Expertise in Figma and modern design/prototyping tools.
  • Proven ability to translate technical requirements into intuitive interfaces.
  • Experience conducting user research and usability testing.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions.
  • Experience with component-based design systems.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with low-code/no-code platforms or developer-focused tools.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integration platforms, or technical product UX.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  • Experience establishing scalable UX processes in high-growth environments.

Why Join Fastn?

  • Shape the UX vision of a category-defining integration platform.
  • Drive meaningful product improvements in a high-impact role.
  • Work closely with passionate product and engineering teams solving real user problems.
  • Opportunity to grow into a design leadership position as the company scales.
  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a flexible remote work environment.

AUIB seeks a strategic, collaborative, values-driven leader to serve as the Associate Dean of the College of Dentistry. The Associate Dean will have an ambitious vision for AUIB Dentistry that harnesses talent, creativity, and diversity. The Associate Dean will support the dean, who is the administrative and educational head of the College of Dentistry.

This Position Will Be Responsible For

  • Recruiting and retaining the college’s clinical faculty and staff in response to programmatic needs and encouraging their professional development.
  • In consultation with the chairs and directors of the concerned departments and divisions and appropriate committees, as specified in the policies, recommend to the college dean the appointment, tenure, promotion, retention, sabbatical leave, annual salary increase and retirement actions of any faculty member and administrative officer of the college.
  • Developing the clinical component of the college’s curriculum of the College.
  • Developing clinical continuing education and post-graduate programs to develop the advanced skills of practicing dentists.
  • Securing, in consultation with the Dean, the necessary accreditation and regulatory affairs associated with the profession and practice of dentistry.
  • Establishing the necessary academic quality assurance system within the college in line with those of the university as a whole leads to programmatic accreditation.
  • Overseeing, in consultation with the Dean, the appointment of academic staff and other technical and support staff of the College.
  • Representing, in the absence of the Dean, the College at meetings of the university, professional associations, governmental agencies, and other groups.
  • Developing the college’s practice and training facilities and creating an environment that facilitates research and scholarly activity.
  • Delegating duties to appropriate individuals or groups whenever indicated.
  • Performing additional tasks as the college dean or other suitable administrative officers of the university may specify.

Required Skills/Abilities

This position requires:

  • DDS, DMD, Ph.D., or the highest professional qualification in dentistry, and be a graduate of an accredited dental school.
  • Leadership experience in relevant academic institutions or universities for at least 10 years.
  • Evidence of academic and research innovations with a track record of scholarly and professional practice leadership in the field.
  • Demonstrated success in enhancing and advancing patient care, education, and research programs.
  • Demonstrated success in securing private, corporate, and/or governmental support to advance the college’s mission.
  • Demonstrated success in managing and leading a complex organization undergoing change.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills; the ability to listen and understand the needs of faculty, staff, and students; and the ability to build strong relationships with internal and external constituents.
  • Effective decision-making and conflict resolution skills.
  • Solid understanding of dental clinical practice, procedures, and scheduling.
  • Demonstrated accomplishments in research and scholarship.
  • Operational understanding of American university educational systems.
  • Preferred experience working and living in the Middle East.

Application Requirements for Positions at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Operador(a) de Arrecadação para atuar diretamente no atendimento aos usuários, contribuindo para a eficiência das operações e a qualidade dos serviços prestados na Praça de Arrecadação. Será responsável por efetuar a arrecadação de tarifas, classificar veículos no sistema e apoiar na fluidez do tráfego.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Efetuar a arrecadação de tarifas, verificando a autenticidade de numerário utilizado, emitindo recibo após a conclusão da operação.
  2. Classificar via sistema eletrônico, o tipo de veículo e a forma de pagamento da tarifa, atendendo as normas e procedimentos da Companhia.
  3. Apoiar, quando necessário, às cabines de pedágio, realizando a reposição de materiais e insumos.
  4. Zelar pela limpeza e bom estado de conservação da estação de trabalho e demais equipamentos utilizados na praça de pedágio, fazendo o checklist e mantendo os materiais em bom uso.
  5. Apoiar na sinalização e orientação dos veículos na praça de pedágio, readequando os cones e evitando filas.
  6. Atuar na abertura e fechamento das cabines, fazendo o checklist e iniciando o atendimento ao usuário.
  7. Manter contato com o Líder de Arrecadação, informando sobre quaisquer ocorrências na praça.
  8. Realizar a reversão de pista, seguindo as orientações do Líder, alterando a sinalização e inserindo informações no sistema, conforme procedimentos estabelecidos.
  9. Atuar como apoio nas pistas automáticas, atendendo o usuário, verificando os dados do veículo no sistema e cobrando a tarifa de pedágio.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência anterior com atendimento ao público ou em funções relacionadas à cobrança.
  • Conhecimento básico em informática.
  • Experiência no manuseio de numerários e autenticação de valores.
  • Habilidade para atuar em situações de alta demanda, mantendo organização e foco.
  • Residir próximo à Praça de Arrecadação.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e cordialidade no atendimento ao usuário.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho em turnos, incluindo período noturno e finais de semana.
  • Conhecimento em procedimentos de segurança e sinalização viária será considerado diferencial.

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica Unimed – Cuidando da sua saúde.
  • Seguro de Vida – Mais segurança para você e sua família.
  • PPR – Participação nos Resultados – Reconhecimento pelo seu esforço.
  • Cartão Flash – Flexibilidade para usar como Alimentação ou Refeição.

Sobre a empresa

A EPR Litoral Pioneiro é uma concessionária de rodovias responsável por administrar 605 quilômetros de rodovias nas regiões do Litoral, Campos Gerais e Norte Pioneiro do Paraná. Com presença em 27 cidades, incluindo Curitiba, a EPR é reconhecida por oferecer serviços de excelência, promovendo a modernização, o desenvolvimento sustentável e a segurança dos usuários. Nossa missão é conectar pessoas e regiões, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento econômico e social por meio da gestão eficiente de rodovias estaduais e federais. Investimos continuamente em inovação, infraestrutura de qualidade e no crescimento de nossos colaboradores, tornando-nos referência no setor rodoviário. Se você busca fazer parte de uma equipe comprometida e trabalhar em um ambiente que valoriza aprendizado, desenvolvimento e impacto positivo, a EPR Litoral Pioneiro é o lugar certo para você.

title: Incident Response Engineer
description:
As a member of the ETMSA team at Crypto.com , you will be integral to responding to and managing cybersecurity threats and incidents throughout their lifecycle – from Preparation to Identification, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, and Lessons Learned – collaborating with a global team of incident responders.

You will apply your comprehensive skills in cyber defense, digital forensics, log analysis, and intrusion analysis to address security incidents across our endpoints, network, and cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for prevention, detection, response, and remediation activities, ensuring that information assets and technologies are adequately protected by leveraging various technologies such as Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and more.

You will also leverage your collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with all relevant stakeholders in multicultural and global environments.

Responsibilities

  1. Report to Director to facilitate all phases in the incident response lifecycle
  2. Be involved in various incident prevention projects to improve Security posture
  3. Preparation:
  • Understand different regulatory and compliance requirements like critical time to report, escalation flows, etc.
  • Take part in self-assessment exercises like Tabletop Exercises, Attack Simulations, Red/Purple Team exercises to make sure the incident response process is working smoothly
  • Develop incident response runbooks, playbooks and SOPs with reference to different regulatory requirements
  • Evaluate the incident response readiness of different layers - people, process, technology
  • Detection & Analysis:
    • Respond to the cyber security incidents escalated from various channels including the 24/7 SOC team.
    • Respond to cyber security incidents in compliance with the local authority / regulatory requirements.
    • Assess the risk, impact and scope of the identified security threats
    • Perform deep-dive incident analysis of various data sources by analysing and investigating security related logs against medium-term threats and IOCs
  • Containment, Eradication and Recovery:
    • Communicate with the stakeholders and provide guidance, recommendations to contain and eradicate the security incident
    • Participate in root cause analysis using forensic and other custom tools to identify any sources of compromise and/or malicious activities taking place.
    • Document and present investigative findings for high profile events and other incidents of interest.
  • Post incident activities:
    • Provide lessons learnt meeting to the stakeholders
    • Lead and keep track on the follow-up activities
    • Document the incident in the case management system and provide incident reports
  • Always ready to jump in, in the event of security incidents.

    • Requirements

    • At least 5 years experience in the Cyber Security industry
    • Strong technical and analytical skills
    • Familiar with the cyber security incident response process
    • Familiarity with AI tools and their application in automating security tasks and processes.
    • Hands-on experience on performing incident response activities
    • Have scripting experience like Bash, PowerShell, Python, Go, etc, and the ability to use these skills to aid in responding to incidents involving Windows, Linux, macOS, as well as cloud environment
    • Have knowledge of cybersecurity tools and software like NGFW, EDR, IDS/IPS, EDR, DLP, SIEM, other log management platforms, etc.
    • Be familiar with the MITRE ATT&CK Framework and/or Cyber Kill Chain
    • Be passionate on exploring new technologies and having creative initiative to boost the team capabilities
    • Holders of security related certifications is a plus (e.g.Azure , AWS, CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GNFA, GREM, or other equivalent)
    • Awareness of regulatory and compliance requirements like GDPR, MAS, PSD2 etc is a plus.

    Preferably

    • Fast learner with can do attitude and ready to get the hands dirty
    • A strong team player who can collaborate with compassion
    • Passionate to learn and willing to put in the extra effort
    • Understand the concept of ownership and accountability coupled with sense of urgency and prioritisation
    • Confidence in handling incidents and managing relevant senior and technical stakeholders
    • Possess business acumen/mindset (not only technical) when making critical decisions

Who We Are

Founded in 2010, Novibet is a leading GameTech company with a strong international presence. We operate in diverse markets, including Greece, Cyprus, Ireland, Canada, Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Ecuador, Finland, Italy, and New Zealand. With offices in Greece, Malta and Brazil, our mission is to deliver unparalleled sports betting and online gaming experiences to our rapidly expanding customer base.
Why Novibet

At Novibet, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work, consecutively from 2021, reflecting our commitment to developing a positive, inclusive, and supportive work environment. Join us, and you will be part of a team of over 1,000 people worldwide that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

What We are looking for

As a TechOps Specialist , you’ll tackle challenging problems, monitor live production systems, and ensure smooth platform operations. Your role includes investigating incidents, escalating issues, and working with development teams to resolve problems quickly. You’ll use tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Kibana), and Octopus Deploy to monitor, troubleshoot, and manage IT operations and deployments. Additionally, you'll document processes and build a knowledge base to improve efficiency. Be ready to adapt, collaborate, and solve real-world issues in a fast-paced environment.


What you will work on

  • Provide 1st level technical support to respond, investigate and resolve escalated incidents and service requests through the internal Service Management system
  • Direct escalation to internal support teams in cases that a resolution is not immediately possible and following up incidents through resolution
  • Perform incident management process taking any necessary steps to restore service and return the platform to normal operations as quickly as possible (Atlassian Jira ITSM)
  • Proactive monitoring of live production environment and event management based on internal dashboards and application health alerts generated by monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Subsequent testing conduction to detect and confirm application defects and external service providers issues, following up with the relevant stakeholders
  • Cooperate with developer teams, providing 1st level real time production logs investigation and retrieval (ELK Stack - Kibana)
  • Perform IT operations procedures in the production environment (Octopus Deploy)
  • Perform release deployment operations in the production environment (Octopus Deploy)
  • Hands-on handling and troubleshooting of a wide variety of support matters
  • Build internal knowledge base and document articles to improve internal incident management process
  • Speedily interpret and analyze data from various sources in a fast-moving and changing environment

What you bring

  • BSc or Academy degree in Information Technology or related field
  • At lease 1-2 years of experience in a production support environment
  • Prior experience in iGaming industry will be considered an asset
  • ITIL Foundation certified or equivalent experience working in an organization adopting ITIL best practices will be a strong asset
  • Experience working in an organization adopting Incident Management and IT operations best practices will be a strong asset
  • Microsoft certifications would be considered as an asset in this area
  • Nice to have experience with monitoring tools and applications such as Grafana, Zabbix, Prometheus, PRTG, Nagios and Kibana
  • Nice to have experience with ITSM tools like Atlassian Jira, Confluence and Opsgenie
  • Willingness to work both day and night shifts in a rotation
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Ability to efficiently solve problems and attention to detail

What we offer

We truly value our people at Novibet! Within our vibrant, dynamic, and fast-paced environment, we encourage everyone to reach their full potential while enjoying every step of the journey. Here’s how we make that happen:

  • Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary and bonus scheme
  • ️Health insurance: Group health & medical insurance package
  • Top-Notch Equipment: All the tools you need for your role

  • Transportation: Coverage of public transportation expenses
  • Nutrition: Meal Vouchers
  • Inclusive Environment: A welcoming, international, and multicultural team
  • Engaging Activities: Exciting events, sports, and team-building activities

Salvador

#VemSerOC

Pioneira no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, a Oncoclínicas&Co foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.

Na essência da Oncoclínicas&Co , o paciente é o centro de tudo. É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança. Aqui na Oncoclínicas&Co valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.

O que você irá fazer:

Responsável por desenvolver atividades de enfermagem, sob sua responsabilidade, conforme procedimentos e protocolos clínicos e hospitalares de rotina e/ou específicos, respeitando a legislação vigente e dentro dos critérios de qualidade e padronização da assistência prestada pelo Grupo.

O que você precisa ter:

• Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem e COREN Ativo;

• Experiência em Oncologia;

• Desejável Pós Graduação em Oncologia ou em Hematologia.

Local e horário de trabalho:

• NOB Lauro de Freitas / Salvador

• 2ª a 5ª 09 as 19hs e 6ª 09h as 18h

O que oferecemos:

Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos o PROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas

Para contribuir com sua saúde oferecemos o DR. AON – uma central de saúde que oferece telepsicologia, orientação médica, nutricional, acompanhamento do pré-natal de gestantes e teleatendimento médico.

Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos o PLANO DE SAÚDE e PLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.

É claro que também temos um SEGURO DE VIDA que cobre as doenças ocupacionais.

Pensando em contribuir com sua refeição na hora do almoço, oferecemos o VALE REFEIÇÃO ou um VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO .

Para o seu salário render mais temos a ALLYA – plataforma de descontos.

E para se manter saudável, disponibilizamos o GYMPASS.

No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com o DAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.

Venha construir com a gente!

E faça parte do time de pessoas extraordinárias que atuam com a missão de vencer o câncer!

description:
Na Cooperflora, a área de logística é essencial para garantir que as flores cultivadas pelos nossos cooperados cheguem com qualidade e pontualidade aos clientes em todo o Brasil. Como Operador Logístico, você será parte fundamental desse processo, atuando em diversas etapas do fluxo logístico, desde o recebimento e separação dos produtos até a expedição e transporte.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  1. Organizar e separar as flores e produtos, garantindo a integridade e a qualidade;

  1. Experiência prévia em logística ou armazém (desejável);

  4. Disponibilidade para trabalhar à tarde e à noite. Sextas e sábados trabalhamos de forma intercalada: na semana em que o colaborador trabalha na sexta-feira, ele folgará no sábado; e quando trabalhar no sábado, folgará na sexta.

BENEFÍCIOS

  1. Fretado, vale transporte ou ajuda de custo para deslocamento (sem desconto em folha);

  3. Plano de saúde (Unimed);

title: Banco de Talentos: Desenvolvedor(a)
description:
Nosso propósito é transformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas, e pode ser o seu também!

Somos uma GovTech pioneira no desenvolvimento de sistemas inteligentes em nuvem para gestão pública no Brasil, focados na construção de cidades inteligentes. Fomos os primeiros da América Latina a desenvolver sistemas de gestão em cloud computing, considerando empresas públicas e privadas. Criamos ainda a primeira Inteligência Artificial para gestão pública, a Dara, que foi premiada duas vezes em 1° lugar como a melhor solução do Brasil para cidades inteligentes. Hoje, atuamos diariamente para transformar e descomplicar a gestão pública através do que há de melhor na tecnologia, com uma solução única e inteligente para gestão das cidades, seja na Contabilidade, na Saúde, na Educação, ou em mais de uma dezena de áreas.

A IPM é formada por mais de 600 pessoas apaixonadas pela inovação e transformação digital das cidades. Somos movidos por grandes desafios e pelo nosso impacto, e temos um sonho maior ainda: transformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas através do melhor da tecnologia.

Estamos crescendo Brasil afora, e sempre lançando novas soluções que estão transformando o futuro de pessoas e cidades. Nos últimos anos, conquistamos diversos prêmios e certificações da consultoria internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW). Em 2022, fomos reconhecidos como um dos 5 melhores times de RH do Brasil; em 2023, figuramos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar pela segunda vez no ranking Mulher e pela primeira vez no ranking LGBTI+; e em 2024, recebemos pela 5ª vez consecutiva a certificação de uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar. Além disso, em 2024, alcançamos o 1º lugar nacional no Prêmio Connected Smart Cities, sendo premiados pela melhor solução para cidades inteligentes no Brasil.

Aqui, valorizamos a inovação, colaboração, sentimento de dono, foco no cliente, atitude descomplicada e ágil, e a mão-na-massa. Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos tão motivados pelo nosso propósito e impacto quanto nós somos, que sejam apaixonados pela tecnologia, e que tenham muita garra para fazer acontecer.

Venha construir o futuro da gestão pública na IPM!
